outcome: Counts of Clostridioides difficile and Clostridium perfringens
Fecal oral polio vaccine-specific IgA levels
cohort: Healthy term formula-fed infants aged 21-26 days
finding: Infant formula supplemented with MOS shifts the gut microbiota and metabolic signature closer to that of human milk-fed infants, promotes bifidobacteria growth, reduces fecal pathogens, and improves intestinal immune response.
mod_finding: The gut microbiota composition of caesarean-born infants in the experimental group (MOS-supplemented formula) was different from caesarean- or vaginally born infants in the control group and closer to that of vaginally born, human milk-fed infants.
